en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest – May 4, 2026
en.summary: Today's highlights include Forbes on AI's unique chance to embed accessibility, an all-terrain wheelchair boosting outdoor access in South Dakota, Kansas City's Roy Blunt Luminary Park prioritizing inclusive design, Tainan's Star Cup croquet tournament promoting sports for disabled and elderly, and upgrades to the tax filing system adding more accessible web operations.

highlights.title: Artificial Intelligence Has One Chance To Get Accessibility Right - Forbes
All-terrain wheelchair provides outdoor accessibility in SD - KELOLAND.com
Heart of Kansas City: Roy Blunt Luminary Park to focus on accessibility - KCTV
Star Cup Disabled and Elderly Leisure Croquet Tournament Promotes Inclusive Sports Environment in Tainan
Tax Filing System Upgrade Adds More Friendly Accessible Web Operations
